This Bio-Implant gives the recipient some kind of Natural Weapon, whether in the form of bone spurs on the knuckles, claws from the fingertips, or some other kind of extension of the recipient's bone structure. When a creature with this Bio-Implant makes an
, it may choose to use its Natural Weapons, dealing 1d6 points of Slashing damage, Piercing damage, or Bludgeoning damage with the attack instead of normal
damage. A creature with this Bio-Implant is always considered armed with its Natural Weapons.
